mentions.h: WOMEN'S SURREY C.C. LEAGUE DIVISION ONE RACE 3 - LIGHTWATER PARK, BAGSHOT, 13 JAN 2001

mentions.note: born 12.2.88 (as printed); 200 metres 30.3 U13 (Battersea Park 8Jul); 800 metres 2:32.0 U13 (Battersea Park 8Jul); Long Jump 3.32 U13 (Battersea Park 8Jul); Shot Putt (2.72kg) 5.17 U13 (Battersea Park 19Aug); 4x100 metres Relay 59.4 team U13 (Battersea Park 19Aug)

photos.c: Far left: Louise Collier storms home to win the Surrey County AA U13G 800m in 2:39.6. In third place, behind no. 19, is Lizzie Hodges whose 2:42.1 earned her the bronze. Louise went on to top our 2000 ranking lists at the two lap event and again Lizzie was third.
